newsitem.title: USA: Lucent to offer debit card pay phones.
newsitem.headline: Lucent to offer debit card pay phones.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc said on Friday that pay phone service providers can select debit card payment options and wireless configurations for their public pay phones under Lucent's K-set series of SmartPhones.
In an expansion of the K-set product line, this series allows pay phone service providers to support wireless configurations -- making them ideal for use in remote and rural areas.

For consumers, the phones offer the convenience and efficiency of debit-card payment, Lucent said. The new option is in addition to previously announced coin-only, credit-card and calling-card payment options, the company said.
The phones will be demonstrated at next week's American Public Communications Council Expo in Nashville, Tennessee, Lucent said.
Elcotel Inc aided with development of the new phones, Lucent said.
